text_block_list.name: ナレーション
text_block_list.text:
ここはアルケス錬金堂──
ランドソルの路地裏にひっそりと佇む奇妙な部屋で、
鹿の角を生やした少女がため息をついていた。
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここはアルケス錬金堂──
ランドソルの路地裏にひっそりと佇む奇妙な部屋で、
鹿の角を生やした少女がため息をついていた。

text_block_list.text:
……はあ。
運命の王子さま……
あなたは今
どこで、
なにをしているの？
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はあ。
運命の王子さま……
あなたは今
どこで、
なにをしているの？

text_block_list.text: Just thinking about you makes my heart pound so hard I feel like it's going to explode... Because, indeed...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたのことを考えるだけで、
私の胸は
今にも
ドキドキ破裂しそう……
なぜなら、
そう──

text_block_list.text: Because I Love You...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ビコーズ、
アイラビュー……

text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Lou-chan. Louise Marie-chan. What are you talking about all by yourself?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえねえルイちゃん。
ルイズマリーちゃーん。
一人でなに言ってんの？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Iroha-chan?! Ah, Geez! Don't I always tell you not to barge in like this without permission?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
イロハちゃんっ！？
もう！
勝手に入ってこないでっていつも言ってるでしょ！？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Eeehhhh? But I knocked! Like "ATATATATATA"! About ten thousand times over!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー、
ノックしたよ？
あちょちょちょちょーって、
一万発くらい！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: AAAHHH, THE DOOR'S ALL BROKEN?! What do you think you're doing, you superhuman girl?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっ、
扉壊れてる！？
なにやってるのよ、
この怪力娘！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Shucks, you're making me blush~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやあ、
照れますなぁ～♪

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: That was NOT a praise!
text_block_list.orig_text: 褒めてないから！

text_block_list.text: Ahhhh, I heard a loud noise so I came over... What on earth are you two doing this time?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーあー、
大きい音がするから来てみれば……
ったくなにやってんのよ、
あんたたち。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Hey, Sono-san, what do you mean by "you two"? The one in the wrong here is 100% Iroha-chan!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとソノさん、
あんたたちってなによ。
悪いのは100対０でイロハちゃんだよ！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, y'see, Lou-chan. I also believe it's pretty crazy to not notice her after so many knocks. You must've probably been in your own world again, daydreaming.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやさ
ルイちゃん。
あんだけノックされて気づかないって
よっぽどだから。
どうせまた自分の世界に入って妄想してたんでしょ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I-I wish you wouldn't call it a delusional self made world of mine! This is love...! A very pure first love at that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
も、
妄想だなんて人聞きの悪いこと言わないでほしいわ……！
これは、恋……！　
ピュアな初恋なのよ……！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: *sigh* Ah, my Destined Prince... I wonder what I should do to be able to meet you once more...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はあ、
運命の王子さま……
どうしたらまた、
あなたに会えるのかしら……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Your... "Destined Prince"?
text_block_list.orig_text: 運命の王子さま？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I-If you're that interested on the topic, then I'll tell you...! He's... right. The last time I went to town to buy alchemy materials... I bumped into someone running from the other side of a corner with my horn!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなに興味津々なら話してあげるわ……！
あれは、
そう。
この前街に錬金術の素材を買いに行った時のこと……
向こうから走ってきた人と、
角で
バーンッてぶつかっちゃったの！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: And then that person came running to me after I had fallen and said, "I'm sorry, are you hurt?". He so gently held out his hand to me!! Right, that's it... the moment I took his hand, lightning struck... and I realized...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そしたらその人。
転んだ私のところに走ってきて、
「ごめんね、
ケガはない？」
って！　
優しく手を差し伸べてくれたの！！
そう……
その手を取った瞬間
雷が落ちて……
私は知ったの。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: This is... LOVE, isn't it. ...KYAAA! KYAAAAA! I really said it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが、
恋だ
って。
……
きゃーっ！　
きゃーっ！
言っちゃったわーっ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Anyway, is the item I ordered ready? I already told you the size, I believe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ
それはそれとして、
頼んでたやつ、
できてる？　
サイズ伝えてあったでしょ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: YOU'RE THE ONE WHO ASKED AND YOU'RE ALREADY IGNORING ME?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 自分から聞いといてスルーしないでくれる！？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, it's indeed ready. Look, it's the costume hanging over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ったく、
できてるわよ。
そこに掛けてる衣装がそうよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Wow, to think that such a wonderful costume could be made with the power of alchemy. As expected of Lou-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
錬金術の力で
こんなに素敵な衣装が作れちゃうなんて。
さすがルイちゃんだね。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Isn't that obvious? A talent that surpasses even my grandma, who's known far and wide as a great alchemist. That's ME! A genius alchemist master with golden hands, Lady Louise Marie!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふん。
当然でしょ。
偉大な錬金術師のおばあさまを超える才能。
この私！　
天才錬金術師・
ルイズマリーさまの手に掛かればね！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Now that I think about it, whenever someone self refers to themselves as "Lady" usually that means they're a bad guy, no?
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分をさま付けで呼ぶのって、
大体悪者ってソウバは決まってるんだよ？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Wh-Who's the bad guy?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
誰が悪者よ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: More importantly, what are those clothes for?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それより
そのお洋服ってなーに？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hm? They're for "that".
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
例のやつ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ah, now I got it! Those are the perfect clothes to do some "Kan-CHO!" all day! ( TLNote: Apparently, it's the "One Thousand Years of Death" from Naruto )
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、わかったっ！
一日中カンチョーの服だ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, it's uniform for our one-day manager. Doing "Kan-CHO" all day would make my butt hurt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや
一日店長の制服ね。
一日中カンチョーって
尻ぶっ壊れるわ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Wow, that's a nice comeback, Sono-chan. As a reward, I'll give you a "Kan-CHO" right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお～
ソノちゃんナイスツッコミだね。
ご褒美に
カンチョーを差し上げます！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I don't want it. Wait, how do you even figure that's a "reward"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いらんわ。
ってか
なんでカンチョーがご褒美だと思った？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...A one-day manager, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……一日店長ね～

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Hey, Sono-san, is it really necessary for us to hire a one-day store manager? Well, it's true that LATELY our store hasn't been doing that well. I understand that we need to take some kind of action for that, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえソノさん、
ほんとに必要なのかな一日店長なんて。
ま、
確かにうちの店、
い・ま・は繁盛してないし？
なにか対策が必要なのは分かるんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: In the first place, do you even have any idea about who would be able to attract customers for us? We've been in Landosol for just three months and we don't even know a single person yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そもそも
集客に繋がるような人なんて
呼ぶアテあるの？
私たち
ランドソルに来て３カ月で
知り合いもいないんだよ？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... I've got a lot of connections. Due to a corporate slave from the Guild Management Association... I mean, thanks to Karin, a very passionate hard-worker, I was introduced to someone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふ……
アテならあるんだよなぁ。
ギルド管理協会の社畜……
仕事熱心な、
カリンさんの紹介でさ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Look, it's the girl in the center of this magazine cover. She's apparently a fairly well-known and popular idol in Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
この雑誌のセンターの子。
ランドソルじゃ
ちょいと名の知れた人気アイドルらしいよ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Whoa, this girl has a sword! I wonder who's stronger, Iroha or this girl...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
この子
剣持ってる！
イロハとどっちが強いのかな……？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hey, Iroha, it's not the time for your fighting spirit to leak out. ...Well, what do you think, Lou-chan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいイロハ、
闘志むき出すなって。
……ほら
どう、
ルイちゃん？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. An idol guild that sings and fights.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふーん。
歌って戦うアイドルギルド。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Nozomi from Carmina, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
【カルミナ】のノゾミ……
さんねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A few days later, {0} had a date with Nozomi.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それから数日後──
{0}はノゾミと待ち合わせをしていた。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Heeeeyyyy! {0}-kun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーい！
{0}くん～！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Sorry to have kept you waiting~♪ How does it look? Does it suit me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ。
お待たせ～♪
どう、
似合うかな？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Hehe... You really think so? Just kidding, I knew that you'd praise me♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ……
そうかな？
なーんて、
キミなら褒めてくれると思ってたんだけど♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: This is today's work outfit. It's so cute, I wanted to show it to you as soon as possible, so I put it on from home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これね、
今日のお仕事の衣装なんだ。
あんまりかわいくて、
早くキミに見せたかったから、
家から着てきちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right! According to the Producer, Karin from the Guild Management Association personally asked for my cooperation for this task.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
そうだよ！
プロデューサーの話だと、
ギルド管理協会のカリンさんから、
ぜひ協力してあげてほしいって直々に依頼があったんだって。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: As for you, you're going to act as both my manager and bodyguard, since that's what the Producer asked. I'm looking forward to working with you again today♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミは私のマネージャー兼ボディーガードとして、
プロデューサーにお仕事頼まれたんだよね。
改めて
今日はよろしくね♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: However... It's rare for us to get a direct request from Karin. I wonder if this is because I'm going to help a newly made guild's shop today? It seems like this wasn't a generic request, but a direct one just for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
カリンさんから直々に依頼って珍しいよね。
まだできて間もないお店
ギルドの手伝いだからなのかな？
一般の募集じゃなくて
直接依頼ってことになったみたい。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪ You might be able to reach the answer to that question just by looking at my outfit. The shop we're going to now is apparently an alchemy shop!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ♪　
答えはこの衣装を見ると分かるかも？
今から行くお店は、
錬金術のお店なんだってさ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? You say that Karin also has a knowledge of alchemy herself? Huh, I see! That tracks, it explains why she's been so cooperative with this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん？　
カリンさんも錬金術の心得がある？
へー
そうなんだ！
なるほど、
だから協力的なのかも──

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Whooosh...
text_block_list.orig_text: さやさや……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm... *Sniff, sniff*. Haah...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……すぅ……
クン、
クン。
はあ……♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry... Your cape swaying in the wind smelled so good.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ごめん……
風に揺れたキミのマントからすごくいい香りがして。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: This is the fabric softener that was released last week, right? The smell of fresh roses is familiar. The Mercurius Foundation has been advertising it heavily, so I've been curious about it, and wow... it's the best...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ
先週発売された柔軟剤だよね？
確か
新作のフレッシュローズの香り。
【メルクリウス財団】が大々的に
広告出してて気になってたんだけど、
はあ……
最高……♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: But that's not all... Your scent melted together with the fabric softener too and... Hah♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
それだけじゃなくって……
柔軟剤の中に溶け込んだキミの香りが……
はあ♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Wait I... WHAT AM I EVEN SAYING!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って私、
何言ってるんだろ！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Crap... It's just me and you today, so I might've let my guard down. T-That was NOTHING! Pretend you didn't hear anything just now, okay...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やば……
キミと二人っきりだから油断しちゃったかも。
い……
今のなしっ！　
聞かなかったことにしてね……！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: A-Anyway... I wonder where this shop is? According to the map, it should be around here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
さーてと……
それよりもお店はどこかな？
地図だと
この辺りのはずなんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Let's see, the name of the shop is Alkes Alchemy Hall. Their tagline is "A shop that has everything you need"...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっとね、
お店の名前は、
アルケス錬金堂。
『無いものは無いお店』……
だってさ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: "A shop that has everything you need", huh? If that's actually the case, then that's amazing! To have everything, the store itself should be massive like a palace, shouldn't it? But there's no such building in this neighborhood...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……『無いものは無いお店』か。
それがほんとならすごいよね！
何でも置いてある宮殿みたいに
大きいお店なのかな？
だけど
この近所にはそんな建物はないし……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...It's so tiny.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……小さい。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, here's the sign. Alkes Alchemy Hall... Yeah, this is it. ...I'm so sorry for calling you tiny!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
看板。
アルケス錬金堂……
うん、
ここだね。
……小さいとか言ってごめんなさいっ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's go in right away! Sorry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃ、
早速入ってみよっか！
ごめんくださーい！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? The door is locked. But I'm sure this was the appointed time, right...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ、
鍵が閉まってる。
約束の時間は合ってるよね……？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Umm, excuse me! I'm Nozomi of Carmina, I will be helping you out today! Is anyone here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あのー、
すみませーん！
本日お世話になる
【カルミナ】のノゾミでーす！
どなたかいらっしゃいませんかー！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...That's strange. Is there no one here...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おかしいな。
誰もいないのかな……？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that makes sense. Let's go take a look.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
そうだね。
ちょっと見てみよっか。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Oh, look. There's a door at the back! There's a sign hanging over there too...um...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
見て。
裏にも扉があるよ！
こっちにも看板が掛かってる……
えーと。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: "Louise Marie's Alchemy Lab"... That's what it says!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『ルイズマリーの錬金工房』
……だって！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Since it's someone's lab, does that mean they do alchemy here too...? Excuse me! I'm Nozomi from Carmina, and I'll be working with you today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
工房
ってことは、
ここで錬金もしてるのかな……？
すみませーん！
本日お世話になる
【カルミナ】のノゾミといいますー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Rattle, rattle!
text_block_list.orig_text: ガタガタガタッ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...!? ...Just now, you heard that, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！？
……
今の
聞こえたよね？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, it's unlocked... What should we do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あっ、
鍵が開いてる……
どうする？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is it okay for us to just barge in like this...? But someone might have collapsed inside... Or maybe it's a thief...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
勝手にいいのかな……？
でも、
中で誰か倒れてるかもしれないし……
もしかしたら泥棒の可能性も……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...We can't afford to dawdle. Then... Let's go...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ぐずぐずしてられないね。
じゃあ
行くよ……！
